title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a semantic search interface via CLI, REST API, and static web UI. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend with FastAPI for serving data, SQLite-vec for vector storage, sentence-transformers for embeddings, and a static HTML/JS frontend. Indexing is handled by a Python pipeline triggered by GitHub Actions or CLI.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, configure a GitHub token, index your repositories using the CLI, and serve the web UI or deploy to S3/CloudFront. Use the MCP server to allow AI agents to search your portfolio.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs
Auto-clustering of repos into capability categories
Static web UI with faceted filtering and autocomplete
MCP server for AI agent integration
Weekly automated reindexing via GitHub Actions
Exportable search results and shareable URLs
